0022600121.text: The Celtics host the Bulls at 1-1 overall and 1-0 at home, sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the East after a win in their last game, with Devin Carter out due to illness. Chicago is 1-2 overall and 1-1 on the road, sitting 4th in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 10th in the East after a loss in their last game, and Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are all out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
